scope: Development host, headed rendering pipeline in headless engines, manual deterministic worker pacing; rAF count over a separate two-second rendering window after the scripted round. Simulation wall time includes step and trace capture, excludes message serialization and hashing. live_game_fps uses a three-second running worker window. Coupling fps uses two seconds with paired simulations running; heat snapshots arrive every 50 simulated ms and remain recorded observations between updates.

hero.source: Same recorded frames, cropped for publication repair a02; no new simulation or neural interpolation

crop_provenance.method: Crop only: remove the partners-only heading and stale footer, retaining pixels from the same recording; no new simulation or interpolated observations.

coupling_selection.rule: First V2E T1a N-SIGN null in ascending seed order whose s* equals the family median; no other outcome enters selection.
